definitions.explanation: Making something stationary or immovable by attaching or fastening it. Also used figuratively for establishing something as unchanging.

examples.japanese: ⟦ねじ→ねじ：00307_neji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{固定|こてい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: I fixed the shelf to the wall.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{固定|こてい}⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{動|うご}かせない→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
examples.english: These seats are fixed in place, so they can't be moved.

notes:
{固定|こてい} means to fix or secure something in place so it does not move. Used both for physical fastening and for abstract concepts (fixed rates, fixed schedules).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {固定|こてい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fix, to secure
- {固定|こてい}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be fixed/secured
- {固定|こてい}⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧: landline phone (literally "fixed telephone")
- {固定|こてい}{費|ひ}: fixed costs
- {固定|こてい}⟦{資産|しさん}→資産：15655_shisan⟧: fixed assets
- {固定|こてい}{金利|きんり}: fixed interest rate
- {固定|こてい}⟦{観念|かんねん}→観念：04125_kannen⟧: fixed idea, preconception

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {固定|こてい} vs. ⟦{移動|いどう}→移動：01741_idou⟧: fixed vs. mobile/portable
- {固定|こてい} vs. ⟦{変動|へんどう}→変動：09936_hendou⟧: fixed vs. variable (rates, costs)

WRITING:
{固|こ} (hard, firm) + {定|てい} (fix, settle). Both characters reinforce the idea of something being firmly set.
